input: Research local foster care volunteering requirements

gold.taskTitle: Research Local Foster Care Volunteering Requirements
gold.taskDescription: Find out what is needed to volunteer with a local foster care organization or agency.

questions.title: Which city or region should this research focus on?
questions.description: Identify the specific geographic location to narrow down relevant agencies and requirements.

questions.title: What type of foster care role interests you most?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants to be a foster carer, respite carer, support volunteer, or another role.

questions.title: Are you open to any age group of children?
questions.description: Determine if the user has a preference for infants, school-age children, or teenagers.

questions.title: Is this for yourself alone or a household together?
questions.description: Establish whether one person or multiple household members would be involved in the application.

questions.title: Do you have a specific agency or organization in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user is targeting a known agency or needs help identifying options from scratch.

questions.title: What is your timeline for starting this process?
questions.description: Understand how urgently the user wants to begin, which affects how thoroughly to research.

questions.title: Are there any personal constraints we should account for?
questions.description: Identify relevant factors such as living situation, work schedule, or prior experience with children.
